part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `Labels.DropMetricName` for the default (slice-based, non-stringlabels) build: `append(ls[:dropAt], ls[dropAt+1:]...)` shifted labels within the shared backing array, corrupting the original series' labels during range queries and producing duplicate series with repeated labels.

The fix in model/labels/labels.go:674 uses a full-slice expression (`ls[:dropAt:dropAt]`) so the result slice has no spare capacity, forcing `append` to allocate a new backing array instead of mutating the input — matching the upstream fix for this issue.

Verified: `TestLabels_DropMetricName`, `TestRangeQuery` (including the `drop-metric-name` case), and the full `./model/labels/...` and `./promql/...` suites all pass.
